index.html.summary: CLGF Docs This is the offical documentation for the Command Line Game Framework (CLGF) library. About CLGF is a simple game framework that allows users to program games which run in the command line. It's a little hobby project I wrote so that I could explore game development concepts without having to learn a whole new tool like Unity or Godot. I decided to make the library public just in case anyone would find it interesting and want to use it! Links Project's GitHub page: https://github.com/JacobGGH/CLGF How to use tutorial: https://youtu.be/b9SqcLTvZz0 Documentation: See the "API" tab!
